dominant_strengths: Strong vertical rhythm with confident headline weight and gradient accent that anchors the dark canvas effectively
Feature cards have consistent icon-tile treatment, tidy two-line copy, and restrained color coding for differentiation
Glow on the app mark and CTA establishes a coherent purple-violet identity without oversaturating the page
dominant_weaknesses: Layout is a generic centered onboarding stack — nothing structurally distinguishes Oneiro from a hundred AI SaaS splash pages
Three feature cards read as repetitive blocks; no hierarchy, scale variation, or visual proof of the 'design intelligence' claim
Reflective payoff is thin — copy promises taste-aware AI but the page itself shows zero taste artifacts, samples, or personality
fix_priorities: Replace the three identical cards with differentiated modules (one hero demo, two supporting) to break the stack monotony
Inject a tangible artifact — a generated component preview, swatch, or critique snippet — to make the product's intelligence visible
Tighten color story: the cyan and red icon tiles fight the violet brand; unify around a 2-tone accent system
Add subtle ambient motion or parallax on the mark to justify the 'thinks alongside you' promise
rationale.norman_balance: Solid visceral polish and adequate behavioral clarity, but reflective depth is weak because the design doesn't embody the intelligent-taste narrative it sells.
rationale.intent_fit: Functions as a competent onboarding welcome screen but treats the brief generically — it could be swapped onto any AI tool without losing meaning.
